title: Alexandre Rousselet
extracted_sentences: Alexandre Rousselet (born 29 January 1977) is a French cross-country skier who has competed since 1998.
His best individual finish at the Winter Olympics was 19th in the 15 km event at Turin in 2006.
Rousselet's best finish at the FIS Nordic World Ski Championships was fifth in the 4 x 10 km relay at Sapporo in 2007 while his best individual finish was 25th in the 15 km event in 2005.

His best individual career finish was fourth in a 15 km + 15 km double pursuit FIS race in France in 2006 while his best individual World Cup finish was eighth in a 30 km event in Italy, also in 2006.
Rousselet was born in Pontarlier, Doubs.
All results are sourced from the International Ski Federation (FIS) .
